newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inapa sees substantially higher H1 '97 net.
newsitem.headline: Inapa sees substantially higher H1 '97 net.

text.p: Portuguese pulp group Inapa-Investimentos, Participacao e Gestao expected to post a first half 1997 profit substantially higher than the 0.4 billion escudos profit in the first half 1996, its president said.
"Inapa's profit in the first half was substantially superior to that obtained in the first six months of 1996," Vasco Pessanha told a news conference.
He declined to give a figure.
He told reporters that Inapa forecast a consolidated net profit of 1.5 billion escudos in 1997, up from 1.05 billion in 1996.
